summary.text: In January 2026 X posts, Bhattacharya discussed AI use in science and scholarship, saying his post was not anti-AI use in paper writing and urging authors to be honest about AI use in papers (s5, s6). Earlier X posts from 2024 show him criticizing California's SB 1047 as an anti-AI bill and "regulating math," while also raising concerns about government use of AI censorship tools (s13, s31, s32, s33). In official statements as NIH director, he described AI as providing new possibilities for science and medicine and as a promising way to do scientific discovery, while emphasizing rigorous research, responsible governance, data security, and that AI will not replace scientific judgment (s63, s64, s67, s68, s69, s71).
